notes: BriefsToken (src/BriefsToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the vendored OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.0.2 ERC20. name() returns Briefs.fun, symbol() returns BRIEFS, decimals() returns 18. The constructor takes no arguments and mints INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1,000,000,000 * 10^18 = 1000000000000000000000000000 base units once to msg.sender, which under ProjectFactory.launchCustom is the factory; nothing else mints, so totalSupply is fixed at launch and can never grow. Transfers move exactly the requested amount with no tax, burn, reflection, rebase, allowlist or exemption logic, so the factory's transfer of the swarm share to the MerkleDistributor, the claims out of it, the single-sided pool seed through the PoolManager and every later swap each move exactly what they say. The contract has no owner, roles, pause, blacklist, freeze, burnFrom, upgrade path, initializer, selfdestruct or delegatecall; the deployer holds no special rights after the constructor mint. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs the token with IMD at 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only and the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (3,500 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply. Per the economics, 80% of the supply seeds the pool and the remainder of the requester's share goes to 0xd6302976e590b9b947da8774b7f1246164e0ce98.
